messages:
Maya: Quick sync - planning a quiet flip of the `safe_defaults_for_unknown_model` toggle in eu-prod on 2026-03-19 at 23:00 UTC. This flag makes requests for unknown model ids fall back to the small-lm safe path. Who can own the flip + smoke? :wave:

Owen: I can take the flip and watch from 22:30 UTC. Will run smoke checks and monitor p95/p99 latency and error rate.

Sophia: Two quick Qs before we lock time: 1) What is the safe-default if we need to abort? 2) Do we have a compact smoke checklist to paste into the runbook?

Maya: Safe-default = OFF (no fallback, current behavior unchanged). Rollout plan: staged ramp 5% (10m) -> 25% (15m) -> 100% if metrics look good. Immediate rollback: flip flag OFF + route back to primary model variants. Estimate rollback ~3-5 mins.

Liam: Ping infra for temporary burst capacity for EU during canary, just in case we see a spike while routes change. @Infra can we lift tenant caps for 30m?

ash-deploy-bot: deploy request queued by Owen for feature-toggle-service@release-2026-03-19 at 2026-03-19T23:00:00Z. CI passed. :white_check_mark:

Jackie: PR #5033 is the flag flip PR - small change, adds fallback routing + telemetry. I can review in 15.

Maya: @DevEx can someone do a quick look at the telemetry keys in #5033? We want the new tags to show up in the per-route cost dashboard.

DevEx: I'll skim now and ack if the tags look sane.

Owen: Short smoke checklist (pasteable):
- curl https://eu.api.redwood/health -> 200
- tail logs: `kubectl -n eu logs -l app=inference-runtime --tail=200 | grep 'fallback='` (ensure no error spikes)
- check console p95 < 140ms and p99 < 350ms for 5m window
- error rate (5m) < 0.3%
- run sample prompt-set `smoke-unknown-model-1` and diff outputs against baseline (sanity check)
I'll run `./ops/smoke/run_smoke.sh --env eu --suite smoke-unknown-model-1` from ops box.

Sophia: Can we also grab KV cache hit-rate and model-cache miss rate during canary? If fallback triggers frequently that's bad signal.

Liam: Noted, will collect kv_hit_rate and cache_miss per-tenant for any rollback reports.

Maya: I'll file an alert silence for noisy thresholds 22:50-23:40 UTC to reduce noise during the canary. We'll keep core SLO alerts active.

Owen: Run command I'll use (ops box):
```
# run basic smoke and metrics
./ops/smoke/run_smoke.sh --env eu --suite smoke-unknown-model-1 --out logs/smoke_$(date +%s).log
curl -s 'https://eu.console.redwood/api/metrics?window=5m' | jq '.latency.p95, .latency.p99, .errors.rate'
kubectl -n eu get pods -l app=inference-runtime -o wide
```
I'll paste the smoke log and metric checks back here.

ash-deploy-bot: feature-toggle-service flip scheduled by Owen for 2026-03-19T23:00:00Z. Notify channel on completion.

Sophia: If rollback happens, let's capture: kv-hit-rate, model-cache-miss, per-tenant error spikes, and any unexpected 5xx traces. Tag eng-runtime and runtime-oncall.

Jackie: Reviewed and left one tiny suggestion on #5033 (naming of telemetry key). Shouldn't block rollout, but do fix after canary. Approving now. :+1:

Maya: Final preflight checklist for handoff to Owen: 
- PR #5033 merged (Jackie)
- infra burst capacity approved (Infra)
- alert silence in place (Maya)
- rollback steps documented in runbook (Maya)
If all green I'll mark this thread ready at 20:30 UTC.

Owen: Got it. I'll post live status updates during flip. If anything looks off I'll flip OFF immediately and escalate to oncall.

Liam: If we rollback, please include the smoke log file and the `kubectl logs` snippet so eng-runtime can triage fast.

Maya: Ready -> handing to Owen. Thanks everyone, will be available for escalation.
